question_text: Describe the role of feedback in the aquarium temperature controller.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: The measured temperature after the heater acts is returned as input. Comparing it with the target lets the next heater decision correct the remaining difference rather than applying heat blindly.

marking_points.criterion: Output effect is measured and returned.
Comparison changes next action to reduce error.
